text: McDonald's Corporation's common stock (trading symbol MCD) is registered under Section 12(b) of the US Securities Exchange Act on the New York Stock Exchange.
short: McDonald's is a New York Stock Exchange-listed company

source.name: McDonald's Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR), cover page
